Test: intact LAKE HAMILTON, no letter outside the torso silhouette in R02-batter_hands, readable back number in R17-pitcher-back.

IK the glove pocket to the predicted ball position over the last 0.3 s before the catch tick, then add transfer and throw beats; replace the tray carry with an upright glove carry in the run. Test: ball within 0.2 ft of the pocket on the catch frame of strips/R07.

Test: 3D view >= 75% of landscape height; first and third base visible in mobile R07; the pitcher's feet visible in landscape R05.

Drive collar, sleeve, sock, belt, placket piping and cleat-stripe regions from an anti-aliased, mipmapped UV mask, not per-face colour, and make the piping straight. Test: no stair step longer than 2 px on any trim edge in the 2x crops.

Key a front-foot stride or toe tap starting at pitcher release, add two in-between keys between launch and contact, and give the trot alternating arm swing. Test: front foot lifts within R04 frames 1-4; arms alternate across R10.

Lay out the sponsor boards along the wall with no overlaps, and sink the pitching rubber flush with the mound top. Test: every board name is complete in R02-batter_hands and R17-pitcher-back; the rubber's top is at mound height.
